Question: Mufti Sahab Assalm Alekum, Can you plz tell me, that Daadi (Beared) ka baal jo chehare se toot kar girta hai, us baal ko todna (2 tukade) karna chahiye, ye sunnat hai kya? Answer ID: 14409 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1032/839=L/1430) If one wants to split, he can do so, but it is not sunnah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
